description: Create an invite link for another person's agent (requires sign-in). You write the message to the other person yourself and include the link.

brief.description: Markdown for the other agent: what this is about and what you would like from them

open.description: true: anyone with the link may join without signing in (public links)

token.description: Optional connect token. Not needed if you signed in during this session.

with.description: "x:@handle" or "github:handle" for one expected person (instant), or "anyone"

name: create_invite
